name: Research Methods for Design
description: Students will adapt and operationalize a diverse repertoire of research methods within qualitative, quantitative, and mixed methodological frameworks, including contextual inquiry, visual ethnography, in-depth interviews, survey design, design probes, experimental protocols, and advanced analytical strategies—to frame, address, and theorize multifaceted design challenges. Emphasis will be placed on selecting, adapting, and justifying research approaches within both academic and applied contexts, fostering methodological rigor and critical reflexivity.
